summary: Approximately 120,340 km² and about 5.1 million people (2005), from Wikidata's Q811 (P2046, P1082). The English Wikipedia article "Nicaragua", at revision 1375099371, opens: "Nicaragua, officially the Republic of Nicaragua, is a country in Central America, comprising 130,370 square kilometers (50,340 sq mi). With a population of 7,097,329 as of 2026, it is the third-most populous country in Central America after Guatemala and Honduras, and the largest by area in all of Central America." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Entity 93 in the Gleditsch–Ward state list, as mapped by CShapes 2.0, a dataset of the borders and capitals of states and dependencies between 1886 and 2019. The dataset gives it 1 period of territorial validity, from 1886 to where the dataset stops, in 2019. Its last capital in the dataset is Managua. This record was written by the import from those fields and asserts nothing the dataset does not.
